title: Exhibition Space Fit-Out Dubai | Finishes & Handover | FANN
description: Plan exhibition-space fit-out in Dubai with a clear finishing scope, materials, artwork, contractor handovers and venue access. Send FANN your stand brief.
heading: Exhibition space fit-out in Dubai
intro: FANN provides fit-out for exhibition spaces in Dubai, with the finishing scope agreed around the stand design, materials and venue access. Separate the surfaces, graphics and fitted elements you need from structural work, utilities and items supplied by other contractors.

caption: Existing FANN fit-out portfolio photograph: a general finish reference, not evidence of an exhibition-stand structure or a specification for your project.

sections.heading: Define the finishing package, not just the look
sections.text: Start with the approved layout and list the surfaces and fitted elements that need work. Record flooring, wall finishes, counters, storage and graphics as separate items. For each, identify the drawing or reference, the proposed material, the quantity still to be confirmed and who supplies and installs it.

sections.heading: Agree the handover from the structure contractor
sections.text: If another contractor supplies the structure, identify the responsible contact, drawing revision and expected handover condition. Record the checks and information needed before finishing begins. Existing construction is not evidence of suitability for a new fixing, display or load; resolve those interfaces with the responsible parties before releasing the affected work.

sections.heading: Keep technical services separate from finishes
sections.text: Identify lighting, power, AV, rigging, internet and furniture in the brief, even when another supplier provides them. Confirm the interfaces and installation sequence rather than assuming the fit-out quotation includes every service. Use the current exhibitor manual and venue instructions to identify submissions and appointed-service requirements for your actual project.

sections.heading: Approve materials and artwork by revision
sections.text: List the material and colour references and any sample review required. Connect each graphic to its dimensions and approved artwork file. Nominate who can approve the package and return consolidated comments. Record later changes against the agreed specification, then confirm any effect on scope and programme before the affected work proceeds.

sections.heading: Plan the last checks and after-show scope
sections.text: Agree a handover checklist for the installed finishes, graphic revisions, fitted items and any outstanding work. Name who checks each item and when access is available for corrections. Dismantling, return transport, reuse and storage belong in the quotation when required; they are not automatic consequences of finishing the space.

faqs.question: What belongs in an exhibition-space fit-out brief?
faqs.answer: Send the stand allocation, approved structure drawings, intended activities, finish references and brand files. Identify the flooring, walls, counters, storage and graphics you need, plus anything supplied by another contractor. Add the current venue manual and access dates so the proposal can separate finishing work from structure, utilities and approvals.

faqs.question: Can finishing start before the stand structure is ready?
faqs.answer: Agree the handover condition before scheduling the finishing work. Identify who supplies the structure, which drawing revision applies and what must be checked before surfaces, graphics or counters are installed. A finishing brief does not confirm that another contractor's structure is suitable, complete or approved for the proposed use.

faqs.question: Does a fit-out quotation include every material and technical service?
faqs.answer: No. Check the quotation for the actual materials, finishes, graphics, installation and responsibilities included. Name any lighting, power, AV, furniture or venue services supplied by others. A reference photograph is not a specification, and a finishing quotation should not be read as an automatic package covering every visible item.

faqs.question: How should finish samples and artwork be approved?
faqs.answer: Agree the finish reference and artwork revision before releasing the relevant work. List colours, materials, graphic dimensions and any sample review in the brief, with one person responsible for returning consolidated comments. If the design changes, confirm the effect on the agreed scope and programme before proceeding with the change.

faqs.question: How long does exhibition fit-out take on site?
faqs.answer: The programme depends on the finishing scope, structure readiness, approved materials and the actual venue access window. Send the show dates and current installation instructions, then agree the sequence for deliveries, finishing, checks and handover. Do not treat a standard number of days or the show opening date as an installation plan.
